job.title: Plan Approval Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Design vessel electrical, automation, and digitalization designs so newbuilds and conversions meet owner requirements, Class rules, IMO regulations, and flag-state requirements.

Responsibilities
  • New-build electrical design and engineering against client, IMO, and flag-state requirements
  • Review vendor and designer specifications and drawings for compliance with owner and classification society standards
  • Liaise with shipyards, Class, vendors, and construction teams on engineering and design issues
  • Compare tender vessel requirements against existing or new-building specifications
  • Support electrical, automation, and digitalization systems through design and construction
Requirements
  • Degree in Engineering or a related field
  • At least 5 years’ relevant experience, ideally with a shipyard, designer, or classification society
  • Background in marine electrical systems, automation, and digitalization

job.title: LNG & LPG Operator
job.description:
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage end-to-end operational execution of LNG/LPG cargoes, from nominations and scheduling through loading, discharge, reconciliation and close-out.
  • Coordinate cargo nominations, supply schedules and loading/discharge programmes with traders, suppliers, customers, terminals, shipowners and surveyors.
  • Monitor vessel and cargo operations, resolving delays, operational risks, claims and contractual issues.
  • Ensure physical trading contracts are executed accurately and in compliance with HSSE, regulatory and company requirements.
  • Maintain operational and trading systems, including invoicing, accruals, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Support contract interpretation, pricing, spot cargoes and new commercial opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to optimise logistics, contracts, processes and operational efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalisation and data-driven solutions.
  • Support global trading activities across different time zones when required.
Requirements
  • Degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
  • 6–10 years' experience in LNG/LPG trading, commercial operations or physical energy trading.
  • Strong understanding of LNG/LPG markets, supply chains, shipping and infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience in cargo operations, scheduling, nominations and contract management.
  • LNG shipping/voyage management and ADP negotiation experience is advantageous.
  • Strong commercial judgement with good understanding of risk, contracts and operational optimisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced, global trading environment.
  • Commercially driven, organised, collaborative and detail-oriented.

job.title: Dry Bulk Vessel Operator
job.description:
Our client, a global MNC requires a Dry Bulk Vessel Operator to oversee post-fix vessel operations of its dry bulk fleet. You will ensure safe, efficient and optimised voyage execution while coordinating closely with vessels, charterers, brokers, agents and internal teams.

Reporting to the Head of Operations, key responsibilities include:
  • Manage end-to-end dry bulk vessel operations from fixture to voyage completion for 12-13 vessels
  • Ensure alignment with Charter Party Agreement; respond promptly to events, handle laytime, demurrage/dispatch and claims
  • Oversee voyage instructions, scheduling, port calls, cargo operations, bunkering and performance
  • Coordinate with Masters, charterers, brokers, agents, terminals and suppliers
  • Monitor vessel positions, bunker consumption, speed and operational KPIs
  • Optimise voyage costs (bunkers, port expenses, agency fees)
  • Manage cargo documentation, bills of lading and letters of indemnity
  • Resolve operational issues and disputes to minimise commercial exposure
Requirements
  • Degree/professional qualification in Maritime Studies, Shipping, Logistics or related field
  • 5+ years’ dry bulk operations experience, in post-fixture, loading, unloading, demurrage
  • Exceptional knowledge of dry bulk Charter Party Agreement, laytime, demurrage and voyage economics
  • Experience with Handysize/Supramax vessels preferred

job.title: Operations Director
job.description:
Angle Recruitment representing a shipping company seeking a senior operations professional to take responsibility for the performance of its marine operations.
 
The successful candidate will be expected to bring structure, commercial thinking and strong leadership to the function while supporting the company's wider business objectives.
 
Areas of Responsibility:
 
Operations:
  • Manage vessel operations and fleet performance.
  • Improve efficiency, reliability and utilisation.
  • Support vessel planning and deployment.
  • Monitor operating costs and budgets.
  • Work alongside commercial and chartering teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management:
  • Lead and develop the operations team.
  • Establish effective ways of working and performance standards.
  • Build relationships across owners, customers, ports and industry partners.
The ideal candidate will have extensive shipping experience, a strong vessel operations background, and proven senior management experience.

job.title: Bulk Operations Manager
job.description:
Bulk Operations Manager
Location: Singapore
Industry: Shipping /Bulk

We are seeking an experienced Bulk Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day commercial operations of a dry bulk fleet, ensuring efficient voyage execution, cost control and strong operational performance.
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage end-to-end dry bulk vessel operations from fixture through voyage completion.
  • Oversee voyage planning, vessel scheduling, port calls, cargo operations and bunkering.
  • Coordinate with Masters, charterers, brokers, agents, terminals and service providers.
  • Monitor vessel performance, bunker consumption, voyage costs and operational efficiency.
  • Review charter party terms and manage laytime, demurrage/despatch and operational claims.
  • Handle shipping documentation, including Bills of Lading and Letters of Indemnity.
  • Resolve operational issues and minimise commercial and contractual exposure.
  • Work closely with chartering, technical, finance and marine teams.
  • Lead and support the operations team and provide updates to senior management.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of dry bulk shipping operations experience, ideally with leadership exposure.
  • Strong knowledge of charter parties, voyage operations, laytime and demurrage.
  • Experience with Handysize, Supramax/Ultramax, Panamax vessels.
  • Strong commercial awareness, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Previous experience with a shipowner, operator or dry bulk trading company preferred.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Tender & Contract
job.description:
Angle Recruitment is exclusively partnering with a reputable shipping and logistics company to appoint an Assistant Manager, Tender & Contract to join their Singapore team.
 
This role plays a critical part in managing the end-to-end tender and contract process, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure competitive, compliant, and commercially sound submissions.
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and coordinate the full tender lifecycle, from opportunity identification to submission
  • Collaborate closely with Pricing, Legal, Finance, and Commercial/Account Management teams to develop comprehensive tender proposals
  • Consolidate inputs from internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on pricing, commercial terms, and risk considerations
  • Review and draft contractual terms in partnership with Legal to ensure compliance and mitigate risk
  • Ensure timely submission of tenders and maintain accurate documentation and version control
  • Support contract negotiations and clarifications with customers where required
  • Maintain a repository of tender documents, templates, and best practices to improve process efficiency
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance tender quality and turnaround time
Requirements
  • Manage and coordinate the full tender lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of commercial terms, pricing structures, and contractual frameworks
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple functions
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

job.title: Business Applications Solution Senior Executive
job.description:

  • 2–5 years of experience in SAP, business applications, business analysis or IT systems.
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance is preferred.
  • Experience in shipping/maritime or finance-related business processes is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Business Applications Solution Lead
job.description:

job.title: Senior Technical Superintendent
job.description:
Senior Technical Superintendent 
 
Singapore / Malaysia
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Superintendent to take Owner-side responsibility for a vessel’s technical condition, machinery, maintenance, repairs and technical expenditure.

Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee vessel machinery, maintenance, defects and operational readiness
  • Manage drydockings, major repairs, modifications and vessel reactivation
  • Review technical proposals, quotations, variations and contractor invoices
  • Manage technical procurement and critical spare requirements
  • Supervise contractors and verify quality and completion of onboard works
  • Liaise with Class, Flag, shipyards, equipment makers and ship managers
  • Oversee the Chief Engineer and engine department from the Owner’s perspective
  • Provide technical recommendations, reporting and expenditure control to the Owner
Requirements
  • Marine Engineer Officer Class 1 COC
  • Former Chief Engineer; passenger vessel, RoPax, ferry, cruise, offshore or older-vessel experience preferred
  • Minimum 5 years’ shore-based Technical Superintendent / Technical Manager experience
  • Strong drydocking, major repair and contractor management experience
  • Commercially strong with budgets, quotations and invoice verification
  • Hands-on and willing to spend significant time onboard in Singapore and Johor
Candidates should be practical and technically hands-on, with the ability to inspect work, identify root causes, challenge contractors and advise the Owner on scope, cost, urgency and completion.

International candidates are welcome; Malaysia-based candidates will be prioritised.

job.title: Compliance Manager
job.description:
Angle Recruitment has partnered with a leading shipping company to hire a Compliance Manager to join their Legal team in Singapore.
 
You will be responsible for supporting the business on compliance and regulatory matters, with a strong focus on sanctions and risk management.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage day-to-day compliance matters, with a key focus on sanctions compliance.
  • Review and monitor sanctions-related risks involving customers, business partners and transactions.
  • Keep up to date with international sanctions and regulatory developments.
  • Provide practical compliance advice to internal stakeholders.
  • Support due diligence and compliance reviews for higher-risk business activities.
  • Review and improve internal compliance policies and processes.
  • Assist with compliance investigations and risk assessments when required.
  • Support compliance training and awareness across the business.
  • Work with different teams on regional compliance projects and initiatives.
Requirements
  • Degree in Law, Compliance, Business or a related field.
  • Ideally more than 5 years of relevant compliance experience.
  • Strong experience in sanctions compliance is preferred.
  • Experience in shipping, maritime, logistics or a related industry would be advantageous.
  • Good understanding of international sanctions and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong communication, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, regional environment.

job.title: Demurrage & Claims Analyst
job.description:
Supporting a leading global energy and commodities trading company with an extensive international shipping network, looking for an experienced Demurrage & Claims Analyst to join a dynamic shipping team.

You will be responsible for managing demurrage and voyage-related claims, ensuring accurate calculations, timely recoveries, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
  • Calculate, prepare, and negotiate demurrage and voyage-related claims.
  • Review charter party terms and assess contractual entitlement.
  • Work closely with operators, agents, vessel owners, and counterparties to gather supporting documents and resolve claim issues.
  • Maintain accurate claims records and ensure all documentation is complete and properly filed.
  • Prepare regular reports on claims status, ageing, recoveries, and outstanding disputes.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to reduce future claims exposure.
  • Support legal and insurance teams by preparing documentation for escalated claims when required.
  • Assist in improving claims processes, reporting, and data management.
  • Build strong relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders to achieve timely claim resolution.
  • Support other duties as assigned.
Requirements
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in demurrage, shipping claims, tanker operations, or oil and gas trading.
  • Strong understanding of charter parties, laytime, demurrage, and shipping contracts.
  • Knowledge of tanker shipping operations and voyage-related claims.
  • Familiarity with maritime law or commercial shipping practices is an advantage.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Experience with shipping or claims management systems is beneficial.
